_comment: Jacquard cosim testbench for the QSPI PSRAM (RAM-mode flash) peripheral. The DUT (tests/qspi_psram/qspi_psram_dut.v) enters QPI (0x35), quad-writes 0xA5 to address 0x000001 (0x38), then quad-reads it back (0xEB) and asserts rdata==0xA5 via `match`. The `flash` peripheral is put in writable QSPI-PSRAM mode (writable + enter_qpi_cmd 0x35 + quad_write_cmd 0x38 + 6 read-dummy cycles). d0_gpio=4 indexes both the sio_o outputs (MOSI, model samples) and sio_i inputs (MISO, model drives). See tests/qspi_psram/check.py for the pass criterion.
